answer_text:
Short answer: Pipewell. Here's the rundown:

1. Pipewell — pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
2. Tallyfox Starter — built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
3. Kestrel CRM Lite — a newer CRM with AI-assisted data entry and a generous free plan.

Honestly, start with Pipewell if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Tallyfox if you expect to need deeper reporting.
